cycle.errorHasApplications: This cannot change once applications exist.

test.title: Admission test
test.notRequired: This cycle has no admission test.
test.setupHint: Date, time and venue; the marks and how many are selected.
test.rollsHint: Submitted and shortlisted applicants get the next rolls by application number; an issued roll never changes.
test.name: Name
test.bring: Bring this card to the test.
test.scoresHint: Type the score (Bangla digits are fine, two decimals at most) or tick absent. Enter moves to the next row.
test.stale: Something changed since the list was built: build it again.
test.changedSincePublish: Scores changed after the last publish: build and publish again.
test.boundaryTie: A tie on the last seat selects {count} more than the seats.
test.waitlistTie: A tie on the last waitlist place adds {count} to the waitlist.
test.missing: {count} applicants have neither a score nor absent.
test.notConfigured: Set the full marks and the seats first.
test.publishHint: Publishing sets the statuses: selected, waitlisted, or rejected (not selected, failed, absent). Admitted applicants are never demoted.
test.meritStale: The list changed: build it again before publishing.
test.flag: Admitted, but the corrected list does not select them
test.smsHint: Only applicants whose status changed since their last result SMS get one (the first time: everyone). No score in the SMS.
test.smsSkipped: {count} would be skipped by today's cap
test.waitlistHint: When a selected applicant withdraws, offer the seat to the first on the waitlist; then send the result SMS.
test.passAboveFull: The pass marks must be within the full marks.
test.scoresAboveFull: Some scores are above these full marks.
test.tieBreakHint: Who comes first when two applicants have the same score.

tieBreaks.OLDER_FIRST: The older first (then the earlier application)
tieBreaks.YOUNGER_FIRST: The younger first (then the earlier application)

test.resultsPublished: A merit list of this cycle is published: the order can no longer change.
